sloka: ओजसा दृप्तवाक्यानां वक्तारं रिपुसन्निधौ ।स्वयूथभृत्यवर्गाणां गोप्तारं भीमकर्मणाम् ।। ६.११४.५१ ।।
transliteration: ojasā dṛptavākyānāṁ vaktāraṁ ripusannidhau ।svayūthabhṛtyavargāṇāṁ goptāraṁ bhīmakarmaṇām ।। 6.114.51 ।।

translations.english: "You are a subduer of the arrogant, who manifested prowess, who tormented the world, who made the world cry with insolent words."
